parameters.content:
## 1. Collect the request
Attendees open a hosted n8n form from the reminder email. Email and Meeting ID can be prefilled through the link, the action is a dropdown, and date plus time only matter for reschedule. Prepare Request holds the CONFIG block you edit once. Incomplete submissions get a clear message.

## 2. Load and route
Fetches the exact event through the Calendar API, builds one clean context object (attendee name, title, formatted time, Meet link) and routes with two simple checks. Missing events show a not-found page instead of failing silently.

## 3. Confirm
Sets the event color to green so the host can spot confirmed guests at a glance, then sends a clean confirmation email with the join link.

## 4. Reschedule
Parses the new date and time in your timezone (ranges, 12h or 24h, ISO), then patches the same event so the Meet link stays valid and guests are notified. Unreadable times return a helpful message.

## 5. Cancel
Deletes the event, lets Google notify all guests, and emails the attendee with an easy way to rebook.

## 6. Log and finish
Appends every completed action to a Google Sheet for reporting, then shows a success page in the form. Logging problems never block the attendee.

## Meeting Self-Service: Confirm, Reschedule or Cancel from a Reminder Email

Cut no-shows by letting attendees manage their own meeting in one click. Add a "Manage my meeting" link to reminder emails. It opens a hosted n8n form to confirm, pick a new slot or cancel. The workflow fetches the exact Google Calendar event through the Calendar API, applies the change, sends a branded email, logs the action to a Google Sheet and shows a thank-you page.

### How it works
1. The form collects email, hidden meeting ID, action, optional new date and time.
2. Prepare Request merges your CONFIG values and validates the submission.
3. Fetch Event loads the meeting by ID. Missing events get a not-found page.
4. Confirm sets the event color to green and emails a confirmation.
5. Reschedule parses the requested time, patches the same event and emails the new slot.
6. Cancel deletes the event, notifies guests and emails the attendee.
7. Log to Sheet records the action, then a success page is shown.

### Setup
1. Add Google Calendar OAuth2 credentials to the four HTTP Request nodes.
2. Add SMTP credentials to the three Send Email nodes.
3. Add Google Sheets credentials to Log to Sheet and create a tab named Meeting Actions (see schema note).
4. Open Prepare Request and edit the CONFIG block: calendarId, timezone, business name, sender, from and support email, sheet ID.
5. Activate and copy the production form URL.
6. In your reminder email link, prefill the form:
form-url?Meeting%20ID=EVENT_ID&Email=guest@example.com

### Customization
- Replace Send Email with Gmail, Outlook or SendGrid if preferred.
- Change the confirmed color in Tag Event as Confirmed.
- Edit form labels and completion messages to match your brand.
- Add a Slack or WhatsApp alert to the host after Build Meeting Context.

## Google Sheet schema
Create a tab named **Meeting Actions** with this header row:

Timestamp | Action | Email | Event ID | Meeting Title | Original Start | New Start | Status

Paste the spreadsheet ID into logSheetId inside Prepare Request.
